<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW255SXr86d2fAJcCNAASjKPb)_

## Merge order

- Based on `main` after #498 (the shared batch report).
- Touches `sp-bibprocess` (doc, tangled `.el`, tests) and the `L b f` keys in `sp-keys`. Independent of #502.
- The other open PRs that edit the BibTeX lint code (the `sp-bibtex-lint--kinds` list, `sp-bibtex--entry-rewrites`, the report in `sp-bibtex-lint--render`, `sp-bibtex-lint-convert`) can conflict in those few lines; keep both sides.

## What changed

Two separate commands, in this order:

1. `sp-bibtex-lint-fix-date` (`C-; L b f d`): the automatic one, ISO dates only.
   - `{2021}` → `year = {2021}`
   - `{2021-05}` → `year`, `month = {5}`
   - `{2021-05-14}` → `year`, `month = {5}`; the day is dropped (and an existing `day` field goes with it)
   - the new fields take the place of `date`; braces or quotes are kept
2. `sp-bibtex-lint-fix-date-text` (`C-; L b f D`): run it after the first, for the dates that one leaves.
   - month as a word: `May 14, 2021`, `14th May 2021`, `May. 2021`, `2021 Mai`; month names in English, German, French and Spanish (`sp-bibtex-date-month-names`)
   - numbers: `14.5.2021` and `14-5-2021` (day first), `5/14/2021`, `2021/5/14`, `2021-5-4`
   - `3/4/2021` (both numbers could be the month) is reported and left, unless `sp-bibtex-date-numeric-order` is `day-first` or `month-first`; a number over 12 settles it
   - it also reads ISO dates, so on its own it does everything; after the first it has only the rest

Both:
- `@misc` entries (`sp-bibtex-date-keep-types`) are not touched: their `date` stays whole, with the day.
- Never overwritten silently (entry left as it is, listed under "… left as they are", with the reason):
  - an existing `year` that differs from the date; an existing `month` that is another month (`5`, `05`, `{May}`, `may` count as the same)
  - ranges, seasons (`Spring 2021`), approximate dates (`c. 1850`, `2021?`), impossible dates, a `date` that is a macro
- A field that already holds the same value stays; only `date` is dropped. An empty field is replaced.
- Like the other fixes: the command opens the report, nothing is written until `A`; `A` asks once, copies the file to `sp-bibtex-lint-backup-directory` and writes; `d`/`u` drop and bring back entries (`C-; L b r`).
- The report of `sp-bibtex-lint-dryrun` has a section and a button for the ISO fix; `sp-bibtex-lint-convert` has an entry for each.
- Options: `sp-bibtex-date-keep-types`, `sp-bibtex-date-month-format` (`%d` gives `5`, `%02d` gives `05`), `sp-bibtex-date-numeric-order`, `sp-bibtex-date-month-names`.
- Docs: section "Date fields to year and month" in `sp-academic.org` (bullets); `L b f d` and `L b f D` in `sp-keys.org`. No shims, `CHANGELOG.org` not edited.

## Tests

- 17 new tests in `tests/sp-bibprocess-lint-test.el` (ISO forms, `@misc` untouched, month format, conflicts, unreadable dates, one write plus backup and idempotence, the text forms, the numeric-order option, text fix after the ISO fix) and 1 in `tests/sp-keys-test.el`; the every-fix-command test also covers both commands.
- Emacs 29.3 in batch: 102 of 103 pass. `sp-bibtex-lint-test-dryrun-report` fails the same way on `main`.
- Not run on the real `.bib` files.

## Manual testing

- [ ] On a copy of a real `.bib`: `C-; L b f d` opens the report; nothing is written yet
- [ ] `date = {2021}` is listed as `year = {2021}`; `{2021-05-14}` as `year` and `month = {5}` with "day 14 dropped"
- [ ] A `@misc` with a full date is not listed and keeps its `date`
- [ ] A range, a `May 14, 2021` date and a differing `year` are under "Date fields left as they are", with the reason
- [ ] `d` on an entry drops it from the fix, `u` brings it back
- [ ] `A`: one question, a backup appears in `sp-bibtex-lint-backup-directory`, entries are rewritten and the conflicts are untouched
- [ ] `C-; L b f d` again: nothing left to fix
- [ ] Then `C-; L b f D`: the `May 14, 2021`-style dates are listed with their year and month; seasons, ranges and `c. 1850` are listed as left
- [ ] A `3/4/2021` date is reported as ambiguous; with `(setq sp-bibtex-date-numeric-order 'day-first)` it becomes month 4
- [ ] A German date such as `14. Mai 2021` becomes `month = {5}`
- [ ] `C-; L b l` shows the date section and button; `C-; L b a` offers both fixes
- [ ] `(setq sp-bibtex-date-month-format "%02d")`: the month is written as `05`

commit.message:
✨ Add a BibTeX lint fix that splits date fields into year and month

sp-bibtex-lint-fix-date (C-; L b f d) turns a biblatex date into year and
month, drops the day except for @misc, and reports ranges, non-ISO dates
and conflicting year/month fields instead of overwriting them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
